title: SUI supplier lifecycle notification v1
description: A notification that information previously returned by Get an Identifier may have changed.

schemaVersion.description: The major version of the supplier lifecycle webhook payload contract.

eventId.description: The stable identifier for this normalized lifecycle event. It is also the supplier idempotency key.

eventType.description: The lifecycle change that requires the supplier to rematch the affected person.

occurredAt.description: The UTC timestamp associated with the normalized lifecycle event.

affectedNhsNumber.description: An unformatted, checksum-valid NHS number. This is the old NHS number for nhsNumberChanged and the current NHS number for gpChanged.
